title: You Build a Sewer, Then Something Clogs It
premise: You build the sewer under Pinecrest Lane, starting from a hole behind a small boxy house with a window face. Each failure adds a layer to the street cross-section: lateral, grade, brick main, manholes, storm sewer. A pale lump inside the main grows every shot until it fills the zoomed frame. Twist: it is not tree roots or toilet paper but grease plus flushable wipes, a fatberg; one weighed as much as 11 double-decker buses. A sign reads Do Not Feed The Pipe.
